spans.s:
चेष्ट् {c1c} A. (चेष्टते, चेष्टित)
1 To
move about, stir, be active, show
signs of life; यदा स देवो जागर्ति तदेदं
चेष्टते जगत्

;
Ś. 6. 27.
--2 To make effort,
endeavour, exert oneself, struggle.
--3 To perform, do (anything).
--4 To frequent.
--5 To behave, act.
--WITH वि {1} to stir, move, be in
motion, move about. {2} to act,
behave.

चेष्टक a. [चेष्ट्-ण्वुल्] Making
efforts.
--कः A particular mode of
sexual enjoyment or coitus.

.
--2 Gesture,
action; चेष्टया भाषणेन च
नेत्रवक्त्रविकारैश्च लक्ष्यतेऽतर्गतं मनः

.
--5 Action,
deed, performing.
--नाशः destruction
of the world.
--निरूपणं observing a
person's movements.

चेष्टित p. p. [चेष्ट्-कर्तरि क्त] Moved,
stirred &c.
--तं
1 Motion, gesture,
act.
--2 Doing, action, behaviour;
कपोलपाटलादेशि बभूव रघुचेष्टितं
